bug_semantics: Concrete CMS deserialized stored PHP payloads with unrestricted unserialize() in Permission, Cache, Search, and the Dashboard bookmark helper patched in the same PR. Permission\Set::getSavedPermissionSetFromSession() unserialized session key savedPermissionSet with no allowed_classes, so a gadget planted in Redis/DB/file session storage instantiates arbitrary autoloaded classes on read. Permission\Duration::getByID() unserialized column pdObject from table PermissionDurationObjects; FilePageCache::getRecord() unserialized on-disk full-page cache files; IndexedSearch::getSavedSearchableAreas() unserialized config concrete.misc.search_index_area_list (historically SEARCH_INDEX_AREA_LIST); Dashboard::getMine() unserialized user config QUICK_NAV_BOOKMARKS. An attacker who can place a serialized object in those backends triggers CWE-502 PHP object injection when the blob is later loaded; the HTTP trigger itself need not carry the payload. CVE-2026-10721 is CNA-published (not rejected/withdrawn). 9.5.2 / PR 12935 adds allowed_classes at each sink. CNA affected range is git 5 through 9.5.1 inclusive, first patched 9.5.2.
flaw_origin: The unrestricted unserialize-of-stored-data pattern first entered a CVE-named sink on 2010-02-09 in 6c4fb938c3b4b744a192bd7642db2962ab83de56 (Andrew Embler, 'search tweak'), which added IndexedSearch::getSavedSearchableAreas() doing unserialize(Config::get('SEARCH_INDEX_AREA_LIST')) in trunk/web/concrete/libraries/database_indexed_search.php. Immediate parent 9c05cf931df1129ad755e3f39f51ce1d0032cd5f has that file but no getSavedSearchableAreas and no unserialize. Independent later first-writes by the same human author added the same anti-pattern to Dashboard quick-nav (07137dd9c1cef15ea41b0efce10acd56af9f8af4, 2011-10-10), Permission Duration getByID (50b850805a5a3365bf2b7b85ae06f00592ce1199, 2012-02-20; parent tree lacks duration.php), Permission Set session clipboard (1257bfa77ce4e29b725865f126a27e5d04365c14, 2012-06-05; parent set.php has no unserialize), and FilePageCache getRecord (93740c1f0af4a954700e383953dda8b52995dc5f, 2013-01-02; parent tree has no page_cache). Path moves (2012 core/libraries copy, 2014 src/ reorg, 2016 web/ strip) and the 2014 Duration class rewrite only relocated those calls. PHP 7 allowed_classes was never applied until the 2026 fix.
